newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains little changed ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains little changed ahead of weekend.

text.p: Trading on the UK physical grain markets was slow on Friday with most players reluctant to take fresh positions ahead of the weekend.
Traders on the fob market reported little interest with only Feb feed wheat reported traded at 101.50 stg a tonne ex-east coast ports in coasters.
Delivered values were mostly unchanged from Thursday.
"Trade hasn't been bad for December," said a trader.
December is normally a very slow month with little ex-farmer business seen.

Milling wheat fetched 121 stg for Jan/Mar in Liverpool and 115 stg for Jan in London, while forward material traded at 103.50 stg for Apr/Jun in the Southampton, Tewkesbury, Avonmouth and Gloucester range.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at around 100 stg for material in the New Year while in the west 99 stg was paid for Jan and 100.50 stg for Feb.
Feed barley traded at 100 stg for Jan/Mar in East Anglia and the Avon range.
